name: word-roller-dramatic-stop
title: Word Roller Dramatic Stop
description: A vertical roller that fakes you out: it eases almost to a stop on the wrong word, shudders, speeds up again and finally lands on the last word with a small bounce in the accent colour and two lines drawing out to its sides.
useWhen: A build-up where a ladder of words (good, better, great, amazing) ends on a legendary payoff.
A title card that needs suspense and a clear final word.
avoidWhen: Neutral word swaps with no climax: use a calmer roller.
Long words: the window is one word wide and gets wide quickly.
author: lifeprompt-team

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Words in order, separated by commas. The last one is where it settles.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Size of the rolling words in pixels. A wide window shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Word color
variables.description: Color of the words while they roll.

variables.label: Final color
variables.description: Color of the last word and the side lines.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Fill behind the text. Use transparent to lay the block over your own footage.
